carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, dark, roughly rectangular depigmented patch or lesion is visible on the mid-lateral flank, situated between the posterior gill region and the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish (remoras) are visible attached to and swimming alongside the posterior lateral flank.
